tagline: Top rated Estate & Trust Litigation attorney in Saint Augustine, Florida
about: Shane J. Kelley attended law school and graduated from Stetson University College of Law in 1995. Shane Kelley began practicing law in 1996.

Shane Kelley is an attorney at Kelley & Kelley, P.L., helping people with Estate & Trust Litigation issues. Kelley & Kelley, P.L. has an office in Saint Augustine, Florida, serving the local community.

Shane Kelley was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
